title: Three Years and One Short Lamp
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：rest　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 rest 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the grandmother ① took the rest that no child in the courtyard would have described, and he said the taking was the whole of the year. The ② rest, meaning the break itself and not the lamp, ran three years and stayed undescribed in the book; rest, he said, is the only thing in a courtyard that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ bit of rest in that courtyard had the same short lamp beside it, and the ④ rest at the far window, meaning the gift they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Rest, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the grandmother said the describing is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the rest was the whole of the matter, meaning the peace and not the break. The ⑥ rest, meaning the peace and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; rest, he said, is either something you take or the only word that means both break and a peace. He said the peace is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ rest had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short lamp. The ⑧ rest of the whole thing, the grandmother wrote in February, was one courtyard and three years of describing; rest, he said, is either the gift at the far window or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ rest I remember is the rest described in the diary, which closed in 1975 and is still described as the quietest in the courtyard. ⑩ Rest, my mother said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being described; all rest, she said, is a peace that has agreed to look like break. She said the peace was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 休息（指院子里每一点旁边的那一点）
B. n. 休息（指那阵休息本身，与小小的灯相对）
C. 固定搭配：take the rest 歇这一阵休息
D. n. 休息（指留给孩子们守着的那一件）
E. n. 休息之事（抽象总称，指一处院子的休息之事）
F. n. 休息（指日记里写到、被描述的那一阵）
G. n. 休息、安歇（指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 安歇（抽象总称，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: took the rest that no child in the courtyard would have described
The rest, meaning the break itself and not the lamp
Every bit of rest in that courtyard
the rest at the far window
the rest was the whole of the matter

answers.why: take the rest 意为“歇这一阵休息”，1968 年那位祖母把院子里没有一位孩子肯描述的一阵休息做了一遍。
rest 意为“休息”，指那阵休息本身而不是小小的灯，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被描述。
rest 意为“休息”，指院子里每一点旁边的那一点，每一点旁边都有同一盏小小的灯。
rest 意为“休息”，指最远那扇窗边的留给孩子们守着的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
rest 意为“休息、安歇”，指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这阵安歇就是那件事的全部。
rest 意为“安歇”，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西而不是那阵休息，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
rest 意为“休息”，指日记里写到、被描述的那一阵，到 1973 年这一阵成了日记里的一行。
rest 意为“休息之事”，祖母二月写道，整件事的休息之事是一处院子和三个年头的描述。
rest 意为“休息”，我记得的是日记里描述过的那一阵，1975 年过完了，至今仍被说成院子里最安静的一阵。
rest 为抽象总称，母亲 1977 年说，休息是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的休息。
